_comment: The ONE judgment in the pipeline: which eBay category branches count as ENGINE parts (Rule B). A listing whose categoryId is a descendant of any 'include' ancestor -> Rule B (fitment restricted to the donor's engine). Everything else -> Rule A (whole chassis family). 'exclude' ids override include (forced Rule A). See docs/DESIGN.md sec 6.1. Fill the candidate IDs after running scripts/ebay_fetch_categories.py, then decide include/exclude with the owner.
_default_note: If a listing's category is not in the fetched tree, default to Rule B (narrower/safer): over-narrowing loses a little reach but never creates a wrong-engine false positive.

include_ancestors.name: Car & Truck Engines & Engine Parts
include_ancestors.note: Core, unambiguous engine parts (complete engines, heads, pistons, crankshafts, camshafts, timing, oil pans, valve covers, gaskets, etc.).

candidate_ancestors_to_decide.name: Air Intake & Fuel Delivery (fuel injectors, throttle bodies, intake manifolds, fuel pumps)
candidate_ancestors_to_decide.reason: Injectors/throttle bodies/intake manifolds are engine-tied; fuel tanks/lines are more chassis-shared - may split.

candidate_ancestors_to_decide.name: Ignition Systems (coils, plugs, distributors)
candidate_ancestors_to_decide.reason: Engine-specific, though some plugs are near-universal.

candidate_ancestors_to_decide.name: Cooling Systems (radiators, water pumps, thermostats)
candidate_ancestors_to_decide.reason: Water pumps/thermostats are engine-specific; radiators are often model/chassis-shared - consider excluding radiators, including water pumps.

candidate_ancestors_to_decide.name: Exhaust & Emission Systems
candidate_ancestors_to_decide.reason: Exhaust/cats are chassis/model-fitment, shared across engines - Rule A.

candidate_ancestors_to_decide.name: Sensors
candidate_ancestors_to_decide.reason: Mixed: engine sensors (MAF, O2, crank) vs chassis sensors (ABS, park).
